svg.title: Bench test wiring: ESP32 Feather V2 driving two 150-pixel WS2815 runs through a 74AHCT125N
svg.desc: GPIO 27 and GPIO 33 feed gates 1 and 2 of a 74AHCT125N level shifter powered at 5 V. Each gate output goes through a 470 ohm resistor to the data input of one 150-pixel run. Both runs share one 12 V supply with a 1000 uF capacitor; all grounds are one net.
svg.text: ground (all ground symbols are one net)
Both runs are fed in parallel from the same 12 V supply. BI is tied to GND at each run head.
Bench limit: keep brightness ≤ 48 with all 300 pixels white on the 2 A adapter.
